Resolves #19168

`Neo.canvas.Base` now acquires the context a subclass declares: `contextType` (default `'2d'`) and `contextAttributes` (default `null`, passed only when set) reach `getContext()` in `waitForCanvas`, and a `null` context is reported once and leaves the renderer idle (no size update, no mounted hook, no loop) instead of starting a loop it cannot draw. The four Portal canvases keep the 2d default and are not in the diff.

Evidence: L3 (the D#19151 observatory renderer, run in the engine's canvas worker on this head with the two configs in place of its `waitForCanvas` override) → L2 required for AC-1..4 (unit-shaped by the ticket), L3 for AC-5. Residual: none.

Micro-review eligible: capability — one file (two configs, one guard on one method) plus one spec; no consumer change.

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | CI: `test/playwright/unit/canvas/ContextAcquisition.spec.mjs` — "the default renderer asks for a bare 2d context": `getContext` called once with `['2d']`; no Portal canvas in the diff |
| AC-2 | CI: same spec — "a subclass declares the context type and its creation attributes": `['webgl2', attributes]`, the config object itself; `context`, `canvasSize`, `onGraphMounted`, first loop tick |
| AC-3 | CI: same spec — "a null context leaves the renderer idle and says why": `context` and `canvasSize` null, no hook, no tick, one error naming the class and the type |
| AC-4 | Outside CI: red-first at `origin/dev` (`2d993a26cb`, base unmodified, this spec) — 2 failed (AC-2: the base passes `'2d'`; AC-3: `canvasSize` received `{height: 45, width: 139}`), 1 passed (AC-1, the control). At this head 3/3; the canvas-owning tree (`unit/canvas`, `component/Canvas*`, `worker/Canvas*`, portal `TimelineCanvas`) 63/63 |
| AC-5 | Outside CI, delivered pre-merge: the observatory witness (D#19151 H3-a) replaced its 16-line `waitForCanvas` override with `contextType: 'webgl2'` + `contextAttributes: {antialias: false, powerPreference: 'high-performance'}` and moved `buildScene()` into `onGraphMounted`; on this head in the canvas worker (`webpack serve`, Chromium, ANGLE Metal / Apple M5 Max): canvas 946×1534, level full, 1,000,000 edges drawn at 104–106 fps over `requestAnimationFrame`, zero console errors |

## Deltas from ticket
- `contextAttributes` is passed only when set (`getContext(type)` vs `getContext(type, attributes)`), so the default keeps today's one-argument call exactly; the ticket sketched `|| undefined`.
- The error line also names the `canvasId`.
- AC-5 moved from post-merge to delivered: the witness ran on this head (row above).

## Test Evidence
- Red-first and the canvas-worker run as in the AC-4 / AC-5 rows; the witness app lives outside the repository (D#19151 archives it), so its run is a receipt, not a spec.
- All other coverage runs in CI.

## Post-Merge Validation
- [ ] The AC-5 receipt is posted on D#19151 once the PR merges (its OQ7 row names this hook as the first engine sub).
